name: Founder Education & Decision Intelligence
description: Deterministic strategic framework to synthesize founder learning modules, evaluate decision confidence scores, log structured decision journals, apply mental models, and accelerate executive decision mastery.
frameworks: 7-Core Founder Mental Models (First Principles, Second-Order Thinking, Inversion, Opportunity Cost, Margin of Safety, Conway's Law, Pareto Principle)
logic: The velocity and quality of founder decisions dictate organizational trajectory. Unstructured intuition, cognitive biases, unexamined trade-offs, or unlogged decisions lead to repeated mistakes and strategic drift. Execute systematic founder education and decision intelligence.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Identify Learning & Decision Need -> Analyze Active Strategic Bottlenecks (`spe_01`, `suf_01`, `ocs_01`) -> Determine Required Knowledge Domain
Step 2: Synthesize Executive Learning Brief -> Generate Tailored Learning Module with Core Principles, Case Studies & Practical Heuristics
Step 3: Apply Mental Models & Scenario Analysis -> Evaluate Decision Options using First Principles, Inversion & Opportunity Cost
Step 4: Compute Decision Confidence Score -> Evaluate Evidence Quality, Alignment, Financial Impact & Historical Outcomes (0-100%)
Step 5: Executive Decision Journaling -> Log Decision Record (Rationale, Alternatives Considered, Trade-offs, Review Timeline)
Step 6: Executive Sign-Off & Approval -> Broadcast WebSocket Approval Request via ExecApprovalManager for Strategic Decisions
Step 7: Export Education & Decision Package -> Generate Curriculum JSON, Decision Journal CSV, Mental Models Dashboard HTML & Manifest -> Archive in Vault
Step 8: Post-Decision Review & Learning Loop -> Register Review Triggers in PCL Daemon -> Audit Decision Outcomes against Initial Hypotheses
bestPractices: Never make a major strategic decision on raw intuition alone; require a structured Decision Journal entry with alternatives and trade-offs.
Require a minimum Decision Confidence Score of 70% before proceeding to execution; identify key assumptions if confidence is low.
Audit decision outcomes quarterly against initial hypotheses to continuously improve organizational intelligence.
